IF a disease name or disease acronym functions as a prenominal (attributive) element that directly precedes a head noun in a noun–noun compound (including adjectival forms such as “G6PD deficient”), THEN annotate the disease span as **Modifier**.
The head noun that licenses this label may be a gene or locus noun, a protein or enzyme noun, a phenotype noun, a population, study, or risk noun, or a case-group noun.
